summary: Calls sub_4C2990(this) to obtain an integer, then invokes ConditionalCallWrapper_29b0(this, result) and returns whatever it returns. The outer function is a thin delegation chain over two callees.

local_names.this: object pointer forwarded to both callees
local_names.v2: integer result of sub_4C2990 passed as the wrapper's second argument

operations.description: Call sub_4C2990(this) and store its integer result.
Call ConditionalCallWrapper_29b0(this, v2), passing the object and the helper result.

unresolved: Semantics of sub_4C2990 (whether v2 is a condition, a selector, or payload) are unknown; its function body is outside this packet.
Semantics of ConditionalCallWrapper_29b0 (what it conditionally invokes on 'this') are unknown; its function body is outside this packet.
The canonical name DelegationChain is a legacy ABI label, not independently confirmed behavior.
